title: Decode remote bytes
responsibility: Decode base64 and verify its declared byte length and SHA-256 hash.

inputs.name: remoteBinary.value
inputs.description: Base64 data with encoding, declared byte length and SHA-256 hash.

outputs.name: unreadableMedia
outputs.description: Message for unsupported encoding or unreadable base64.

outputs.name: damagedMedia
outputs.description: Message for content that does not match its declared length or hash.

outputs.name: remoteBinary
outputs.description: Decoded bytes after length and hash verification.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Rejects unreadable content or a length/hash mismatch; underlying digest failures can also propagate.
